notes.title: Candy Rangers release date!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello again![/p][p][/p][p]We're opening the door to fan translations. To apply, go to this discord server and ping @mechano stating the language you want to work on. I'll give you access to the files and dedicated channel so you can start right away![/p][p]Here's the link
[url="https://discord.com/invite/N8AWj9gHZp"]https://discord.com/invite/N8AWj9gHZp[/url][/p][p][/p][p]And, if you didn't know, we're release October 2nd on Steam and consoles! We spent a long time on QA and porting but it's finally over! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44851013/eea00aba2afd7e45b9a60fc22be74f000205916f.png"][/img][/p][p]See you october 2nd everyone![/p]
